verdict.rationale: OpenHands ships an official, first-party CLI: running `openhands` launches an interactive terminal mode by default. The documentation covers natural-language tasks, resuming previous conversations, auto-approving actions, and pausing with Esc, and the pricing page lists the CLI alongside the GUI and TUI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented headless or non-interactive scripting usage of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Command Line Interface (CLI) is the default mode when you run `openhands`. It provides a rich, interactive experience directly in your terminal.
Web-based GUI, Terminal UI, and CLI
